channel.title: Sunmeld Journal
channel.description: Notes from the making of Sunmeld, a space merge duel against AI opponents.

item.title: Moving the stones onto a game engine
item.description: Why Sunmeld's falling stones and other moving parts now run on a game engine, and how we checked them.

item.title: The sound switch that did nothing
item.description: Why Sunmeld's sound setting stayed silent for a while, and what we added so that a merge can be heard.

item.title: Progress stays on the phone — and can sync across your devices
item.description: How Sunmeld saves your game progress locally, and what happens when you play on another device with the same Apple account.

item.title: A screen of its own for tablets
item.description: Why Sunmeld on a tablet is not just the phone screen stretched, and how we check many screen sizes.

item.title: One night sky, two looks
item.description: How Sunmeld's look was redone, and why the tub stays dark even when you choose the light theme.

item.title: Could the sun ever appear?
item.description: What happened when we let AI players play Sunmeld over and over: the top stone almost never showed up, and the fix was in the rules, not the AI.

item.title: Where Sunmeld stands today
item.description: A short look at what is in the Sunmeld test build so far, and what is still open.

item.title: How the 12 languages were made

item.title: The daily challenge
item.description: One new game each day, the same for everyone: how the Sunmeld daily challenge works.

item.title: Comeback devices: first move and finale zone
item.description: How Sunmeld keeps a game open to a comeback: alternating first move and a finale zone.

item.title: Three special stones
item.description: A note on the three special stones in Sunmeld: wind, frost and hole.

item.description: How the first game in Sunmeld walks new players through the rules.

item.description: A look at League 1 in the Sunmeld test build and how stars are earned.

item.description: A short note on how merging works in Sunmeld and why it decides who leads.

item.description: The first journal post. What Sunmeld is, and why this journal exists.
